title: Choose JotTrade's new visual world
question: Every route will inherit this operating model. Choose one, take the familiar trading-dashboard exit, or re-roll.

options.label: The Section Desk
options.lineage: architectural section drawings and field notebooks
options.thesis: A trade becomes a traced decision whose setup, execution, and outcome stay aligned across every view.
options.viewport: A slim project index frames a live daily section: the equity profile runs through the page, trades pin to it with leaders, and one inspector follows selection across journal, chart, and calendar.
options.risk: It becomes diagram theatre if annotations outnumber decisions.

raised.raise: Every selection visibly changes its dependent chart, table, and calendar evidence as one causal system.
Semantic color stays in narrow bands along data edges instead of filling passive surfaces.
Decisive figures gain extreme scale contrast while controls stay compact.
Responsive density drops in declared tiers so the main reading never shrinks into clutter.

options.label: The Closing Book
options.lineage: execution blotters and end-of-day analyst tear sheets
options.thesis: JotTrade opens as today's trading record, with analysis attached directly to each line of evidence.
options.viewport: A compact session header sits above the day's ledger; selected trades open a side analysis sheet without leaving the record.
options.risk: This is the most familiar direction and can look like a polished broker terminal if the journal voice weakens.

options.label: The Signal Board
options.lineage: seven-segment clocks, price totems, and scoreboards
options.thesis: Every metric occupies a fixed signal cell; absence, pending data, and live results remain visible states.
options.viewport: A fixed performance mask shows the session's essential numbers above a banked trade ledger whose cells ignite on selection.
options.case: Trader identification is immediate; long-form notes and strategy editing fit the system less naturally.
options.risk: The display alphabet can turn ordinary reading into work.

options.label: The Tabbed Trading Manual
options.lineage: boxed-software manuals with acetate overlays and section boards
options.thesis: Each workflow is a durable chapter, while filters and detail states hinge over the data as clear working leaves.
options.viewport: A stepped chapter rail opens to the journal sheet; trade details and import mapping sit on hinged translucent layers above it.
options.case: The interaction model is exceptionally clear; its physical metaphor is less native to traders than the lead concepts.
options.risk: Tabs and overlays can become decoration unless every layer changes the work state.

options.label: The Causal Garden
options.thesis: Trades pull visible streams of consequence through the workspace.
options.viewport: A performance field bends around decisions and outcomes.
options.case: The causal model is useful, but traders do not identify with the world and routine entry becomes obscure.
options.kept: Selections must visibly propagate through every dependent view.

options.label: The Spectrum Edge
options.thesis: Meaning appears as narrow spectral evidence around an otherwise quiet record.
options.viewport: A pale journal carries thin color bands where evidence changes state.
options.case: The restraint is strong, but the world neither identifies the trader nor explains the journal's mechanism.
options.risk: It reads as a generic wellness dashboard.
options.kept: Reserve semantic color for the thinnest possible evidence band.

options.label: The Metric Specimen
options.thesis: One decisive figure changes scale while the whole page responds to its selected range.
options.viewport: A single session result dominates a sparse field of supporting measures.
options.case: Scale is legible, but the specimen grammar cannot carry dense journals, imports, and calendars without losing itself.
options.risk: The product becomes a typography demo.
options.kept: Use hard scale contrast to separate decisions from controls.

options.label: The Certified Feed
options.thesis: Each trade is stamped, coded, and certified inside an aggressive information field.
options.viewport: A dense coded feed surrounds one oversized session verdict.
options.case: Its visual authority is high, but it fights long-session clarity and misstates the product's private reflective purpose.
options.risk: Brand noise crowds out trading evidence.
options.kept: Responsive density must step down by rule rather than merely shrink.

canonCard.label: The premium trading dashboard
canonCard.thesis: A restrained dark analytics product with familiar cards, charts, tables, and a compact sidebar.
canonCard.viewport: A polished dashboard summary leads into journal, calendar, strategy, and settings routes.
canonCard.risk: It is easy to learn and equally easy to confuse with every serious trading app.
